_meta.auth_type: OIDC (OpenID Connect — ASP.NET Core Data Protection session)
_meta.cloudflare: CF_VERIFIED_DEVICE cookie valid until 2027-07-01 — major bypass asset
_meta.browser_required: Playwright (Firefox or Chrome with stealth); headless Chrome blocked by Akamai on some endpoints

cookie_files.expiry_note: myssid is Session-scoped server-side; CF_VERIFIED_DEVICE expires 2027-07-01. Refresh myssid via auto-login when 401/redirect detected.

login_flow.step1: Navigate to https://my.silversea.com — redirects to IDP if session expired
login_flow.step2: IDP login form — email + password (johnloucks3@gmail.com / D2MCanal4me!)
login_flow.step3: IDP redirects back to my.silversea.com with auth code
login_flow.note: With CF_VERIFIED_DEVICE cookie loaded, Cloudflare challenge is bypassed. IDP may require device verification on first login from new IP/session.
login_flow.cookie_strategy: Load cookies_silversea.json before navigation. If redirected to login, run full OIDC flow.

api.auth_method: Session cookies — no token required for read operations
api.note: 350 voyages returned across 7 pages (50/page). Pure requests library works — no Playwright needed for pricing reads.

filters.ship: input or select element for ship filter

pricing_scraping.note: Selectors are initial best-guesses. Run discover_selectors() on live page to confirm.

public_site_pricing.anti_bot: Cloudflare — use CF_VERIFIED_DEVICE cookie or Camoufox
public_site_pricing.note: Public prices are retail 'starting from' — TA portal prices may differ. Use TA portal for accurate agency rates.

auto_refresh.trigger: check session health → if expired → full OIDC login → save new cookies

antibot_notes.cloudflare: CF_VERIFIED_DEVICE cookie is a device verification token — expires 2027-07-01. This is the crown jewel. Guard it.
antibot_notes.akamai: my.silversea.com does NOT appear to use Akamai (unlike rssc.com). Standard Playwright should work.
antibot_notes.rate_limiting: Respect 1-2 second delays between requests. No rapid-fire scraping.
antibot_notes.stealth_tool: Camoufox preferred for public silversea.com. Playwright sufficient for my.silversea.com with valid session.
antibot_notes.fingerprinting: Session cookies bypass fingerprinting — no stealth tooling needed while myssid is valid.
